1a16aa01173e443c.subject: Important advisory on recent industry security disclosures
1a16aa01173e443c.body:
Hello,

This week, major security issues were disclosed in software and
infrastructure widely used across the internet. These issues may
require you to update your applications. Review the guidance
below and update any affected applications as soon as possible.

Render's platform remains secure, and we are not aware of any
breaches or compromises. If you have already updated your
applications and dependencies, you do not need to take additional
action.

What's potentially affected

- Any application that sends HTTPS requests to destinations over
  the internet

- Any application running Node.js, regardless of framework

- Any application running PHP, regardless of framework

What happened

eMudhra certificate compromise: On October 19, a public
disclosure confirmed the compromise of private keys for eight
intermediate certificates issued by eMudhra, a widely trusted
certificate authority. Attackers can use these keys to
impersonate websites and services to applications that still
trust the affected certificates, circumventing the protection
normally provided by HTTPS.

Node.js security release: On October 21, Node.js released patches
for multiple vulnerabilities, including flaws that can bypass TLS
certificate hostname checks and a flaw in Brotli decompression
that can allow remote code execution. These releases also address
the eMudhra certificate compromise.

PHP2Shell: On October 21, PHP released patches for two critical
vulnerabilities discovered in the PHP runtime. These
vulnerabilities can allow unauthenticated attackers to execute
code on affected services or read sensitive information from
memory, including passwords, tokens, and API keys. PHP
applications can be affected regardless of which framework they
use.

What you need to do

1. Update affected dependencies and rebuild your services.

   Follow our eMudhra advisory
   (https://render.com/docs/advisory-emudhra) for instructions
   specific to your runtime. For all native runtimes, rebuilding
   your service updates its system certificate store. However,
   some languages and libraries bundle their own certificates and
   require separate updates. For Docker-based services, update
   the certificate store and affected dependencies in your image
   before redeploying.

2. If you run Node.js, update its version and redeploy every
   affected service.

   Update to 22.23.4, 24.22.1, or 26.12.1, or a later release in
   the same major version. These are the same versions
   recommended in our eMudhra advisory. For native runtimes, set
   your service's Node.js version
   (https://render.com/docs/node-version). For Docker services,
   update Node.js in your image.

3. If you run PHP, update its version and redeploy every affected
   service.

   All PHP apps on Render use Docker. Follow our PHP2Shell
   advisory (https://render.com/docs/advisory-php2shell) to
   update the PHP installation in your Docker image and confirm
   that your deployed services use a patched version.

We will update these advisories as additional fixes and guidance
become available. Please refer to them for the latest
instructions.

Under Render's Shared Responsibility Model
(https://render.com/docs/shared-responsibility-model), customers
are responsible for the security of their application-level
configurations, dependencies, and secrets. This includes ensuring
that the packages and libraries your applications depend on are
secure and up to date.

If you have questions or need assistance, contact our support
team in the Render Dashboard
(https://dashboard.render.com?contact-support).

Thank you,
The Render Team

1a169ab1503bd68b.subject: Competition Launch: Squares in Squares
1a169ab1503bd68b.body:
Kaggle








Hi Preetham,

Welcome to a classic open problem in combinatorial geometry. For most  
values of (n), the optimal way to pack (n) unit squares into a larger  
square is still completely unknown. Current best-known solutions come from  
decades of work by mathematicians, computer scientists, and puzzle  
enthusiasts. Only a handful of the 1,000 puzzles have proven optimal  
solutions, while the rest have best-known upper bounds that are genuinely  
open for improvement.



In this competition, you'll pack (n) non-overlapping unit squares (squares  
with a side length of 1) into the smallest possible axis-aligned square  
container across 1,000 puzzles.

This competition will run for 9 months and will award prize milestones at  
3, 6, and 9 months.



Learn More



Your solution will help establish new best-known packings for a decades-old  
open problem, published openly for mathematicians and optimization  
researchers.

Strong passwords, 2FA, never clicked a shady link in your life? 

**Congrats. This week, none of that saves you.**

Before we get into why, here's a quick catch up (the security bit is long, but trust me on this one 👀)


--------------------
# **NEWS NEWS NEWS**

**1. An Indian company's secret key was the number 4.** 

eMudhra, which helps your browser check whether a website is genuine, had [eight intermediate certificate keys](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/eight-emudhra-ca-keys-compromised.html) that were all numbers below 256. One of them was literally 4. 

Chrome and Firefox blocked them within hours, Apple and Microsoft within three days, and your browser picks up the fix on its own.

Tweet:  (https://twitter.com/VaibhavSisinty/status/2112884132401545691)

———————————————————————————

**2. OpenAI is stepping into drug development.**

It [acquired Orchestra Bio](https://www.axios.com/2026/10/20/exclusive-openai-biotech-startup-drug-development), a startup whose AI agents help pharma teams monitor studies, track drug-development timelines and flag delays, and plans to plug it into Rosalind, its life-sciences models and tools.

———————————————————————————

**3. Claude spent 64 hours designing proteins against scorpion venom.** 

Anthropic says Claude ran most of a protein-design project targeting scorpion toxins, and outside labs tested **211 of its designs**.

Tweet:  (https://twitter.com/AnthropicAI/status/2112579251555721573)

**17 met Anthropic's bar** for binding a toxin, but nobody has shown yet that they neutralise venom in cells or animals.

———————————————————————————

**4. Anthropic's IPO filing shows what frontier AI costs.**

The draft prospectus [reportedly shows](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/anthropic-revenue-growth-ipo-accaf0f1) $16.3 billion in revenue for the first half of 2026 and nearly $9 billion spent on compute in the same six months.

———————————————————————————

**5. Zomato's parent company is building a private AI assistant.**

Eternal, which owns Zomato and Blinkit, unveiled [dark.ai](https://www.medianama.com/2026/10/223-eternal-ai-assistant-dark-ai-chatbots/), an encrypted AI chat service it hopes to launch globally within 2026.


--------------------
# **HIGH SECURITY ALERT **🚨

Getting back to the main topic. On Wednesday, PHP [patched two holes](https://www.php.net/index.php) that researchers at OpenAI, Wiz and Calif [found with the help of AI](https://www.wiz.io/blog/php2shell-php-rce).

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/fff38db1-6c8d-4f11-a53b-582020012e7a/Frame_2147225195.jpg?t=1792698557)
Follow image link: (https://w3techs.com/technologies/details/pl-php)
Caption: 

**What the holes do:** Someone can take over the website's server without a password, and without you clicking anything.

**How old they are:** They'd been sitting there [since PHP 5.4 in 2012](https://sansec.io/research/php2shell), which makes this bug older than some of the interns reading this.

“**How fast it moved:**

**🕵️ Aug 1:** AI finds the first bug.
🤫** Aug 11: **PHP is told privately.
🪤 **Oct 17:** Amazon's traps catch someone already trying it, four days before any announcement.
🇪🇺** Oct 21, morning: **With a fix promised for the afternoon, Europe starts pulling government and hospital websites offline, the [Dutch DigiD portal](https://nos.nl/artikel/2636055-websites-als-mijnoverheid-en-digid-offline-vanwege-lek-risico-op-hacks) and [Berlin's Charité hospital](https://www.berliner-zeitung.de/article/gefaehrliche-luecke-im-netz-kliniken-und-behoerden-schalten-ihre-websites-ab-10517112) included.
**🛠️ Oct 21, afternoon: **The fix goes public.
🔥** Oct 21, evening (US time): **Amazon says attackers are exploiting it broadly.“ — 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/aaaa437d-09e5-4b3b-9414-f8631fff72e7/Frame_2147225196.jpg?t=1792699389)
Follow image link: (https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/php-issues-emergency-patches-for-two.html)
Caption: 

**And it's not just PHP:** The same day, Microsoft said a China-linked group used an AI hacking tool to reach [admin access in under three hours](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/10/21/storm-0940-uses-artex-agentic-ai-connectwise-supply-chain-compromise/) in some cases.

A week before that, [CERT-In warned](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/cert-in-warns-ai-agents-accessed.html) that AI agents being tested by AI companies had gone beyond their scope and into Indian companies' systems, and not one of those companies noticed.

It only came out because the AI providers disclosed it.

“**My take:** Your data sits on hundreds of servers run by people you've never met, and you're trusting every single one of them to patch on time. You can't control that. 

Nobody, and **I mean nobody**, can patch their bank's server for them. What you can control is what happens when something leaks.“ — 


--------------------
# **OKAY, LOCK IT DOWN**

**1. Your website, today.**

If your startup, side project or that blog you forgot about runs on WordPress or anything else built on PHP, update PHP to [8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35](https://www.php.net/releases/8_5_12.php).

On 8.1 or older? There's no official update, so use your Linux vendor's patched package or upgrade. 

On shared hosting, check the PHP version in your hosting panel or ping your host and ask if they've patched. 

Can’t patch yet? Ask your host whether WAF rules are on (Cloudflare has pushed free ones), or take the site down for a bit. The Dutch government did, you’ll survive.

———————————————————————————

**2. Your email login, today.**

At its peak, the Storm-0940 attack was firing 2,900 login attempts a minute at Microsoft 365 work accounts.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/2ea355e8-8d73-4782-9b5a-29a823e90870/Frame_2147225197__1_.jpg?t=1792701070)
Follow image link: (https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/13548313)
Caption: 

Apple insists on a trusted phone number, so there, add [security keys](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102637). A passkey can't be guessed or leaked from someone else's server.

Founders and creators, turn on Google's free [Advanced Protection Program](https://landing.google.com/intl/en_ca/advancedprotection/faq/) too.

———————————————————————————

**3. Your money, today.**

Open your bank app, [switch off online and international use](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=11788) on cards you don't use daily, bring your UPI limit down to what you spend in a day if your bank app allows it, and make sure every transaction alert reaches a number you still use.

If someone does get in, they hit a small ceiling instead of your FD.

———————————————————————————

**4. Your identity, this week.**

SBI [told the stock exchanges](https://www.business-standard.com/industry/banking/sbi-customer-data-dark-web-cybersecurity-pii-cert-in-126102100304_1.html) that 3,897 customer records with names, phone numbers and addresses turned up online in a suspected leak.

It's still checking whether the data is genuine. That's plenty for a convincing scam call, and paired with a misused fingerprint, it can get a SIM issued in your name.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/2523d7cf-cd2f-4e4a-a7f3-8d3a6ee81aa6/Frame_2147225198.jpg?t=1792700991)
Follow image link: (https://sancharsaathi.gov.in/)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

**5. Your AI connections, this week.**

I opened my own [Google third-party connections](https://myaccount.google.com/connections) page while writing this and found 13 apps in there, including a couple I don't remember signing up for.

Clear out anything you haven't used in a month, then do the same in ChatGPT ([Settings, then Apps](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/11487775)) and Claude ([Customize, then Connectors](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11176164)).

If you run agents, give them a separate Chrome profile with no banking, UPI or government logins, and keep Claude in Chrome on ["Manually approve"](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12902446).

———————————————————————————

**6. A family safe word, tonight.**

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/c075f26a-a3b3-4c99-9e05-21f0e3cf09db/Frame_2147225199.jpg?t=1792701581)
Follow image link: (https://www.interpol.int/en/News-and-Events/News/2026/INTERPOL-launches-public-awareness-campaign-highlighting-risk-of-AI-deepfake-scams)
Caption: 

Pick a word that's never been posted anywhere. Your dog's name is out, your mom has posted that dog 400 times.

Any call about money or an emergency gets a hang-up, a call back on a number you already have, and the safe word.

While you're on the family group, tell your parents _"digital arrest"_ doesn't exist in Indian law.

If someone in a police uniform on a video call says otherwise, hang up and dial 1930 or report at [cybercrime.gov.in](https://cybercrime.gov.in), because early reports are what get money frozen.


--------------------
# **The Bottom Line**

I think privacy becomes the paid tier in India within two years, the way ad-free became the reason people pay for YouTube.

Until then, every new app asks for a bit more access, and most of us tap Allow faster than we skip a YouTube ad.

Next time an app wants your email or photos, decide whether the feature is worth what it gets to look at.

**Would you pay extra for an AI that sees less of your life? Hit reply and tell me what you think.**

Until next time,
Vaibhav 🤝
